engineering_confirmation_needed: Logical pixel density, integer display scale and texture filtering.
Approved source dimensions and world footprints for each prop variant; atlas versus separate PNG preference.
Top collision spans, anchors, allowed overhang and whether solid side collisions are supported.
One-way versus fully solid platform semantics; projectile blocking rules.
Maximum climb steps and reachable landing widths for both employee movement profiles.
Background layer dimensions, tiling axis, overlap/seam requirements and parallax factors.
Foreground occlusion allowance, render layers and camera-safe margins.
Atlas gutters/extrusion, alpha thresholds and import settings.
level_design_confirmation_needed: Ordered zones and visual changes per zone.
Placement counts and small/medium/large prop families needed.
Critical path versus optional jumps, enemy lanes, checkpoint and hazard clearances.
Approved set pieces; no boss or portal assumed from existing source art.

planned_asset_contract.versioning: Preserve each generated original with versioned filenames; no overwriting earlier artwork.
planned_asset_contract.defaults: No generated art or numeric collision dimensions are committed by this proposal. Actual dimensions measured after generation; Engineering approves collision mapping.

handoff: Engineering owns runtime integration; Level Design owns layout; Art supplies raster pixel assets after dimensions are confirmed. No code-drawn replacements, roadmap edits or runtime edits in this handoff.
